ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENTANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT 2011 (the “Effective Date"), by and between 39 PRINCE REALTY,LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company, having an address at 136-20 38th Avenue, 12th floor, Flushing, New York 11354, (together with its’ successors and assigns being hereinafter sometimes referred to as "Developer") and YUAN CHIEH REALTY, INC., a New York corporation, having an address at 133-57 Roosevelt Avenue, Flushing, New York 11394 ("Seller"). RECITALS: A. Seller is the owner of certain land located at 133-57 Roosevelt Avenue, Flushing, New York, also known as Tax Lot 41' in Block 4973 (such block being hereinafter referred to as “Block 4973")on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens, as more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon existing as of the date hereof (said land being herein referred to as “Seller's Land,”" said improvements being herein referred to as “"Seller's Existing Building,” and Seller's Land and Seller's Existing Building being herein referred to as “Seller's Property"). 1And also including the Rear Parcel (as defined in Article V,below)with the understanding that Rear Parcel shall have been merged with Lot 41, in connection with the recording of this Agreement. 1 1121112.6

Developer is the owner of certain land located at 133-42 39th Avenue, Flushing, New York, also known as Tax Lot 242 in Block 4973 described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon existing as of the date hereof (said land being herein referred to as “Developer's Land", said improvements being herein referred to as “Developer's Existing Building", and Developer's Land and Developer's Existing Building being herein referred to as “Developer's Property"). C.Seller and Developer wish to combine the zoning lots for Seller's Property and “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, effective December 15, 1961, as amended (the Zoning Resolution as in effect on the date hereof being herein referred to as the “Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with this Agreement or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"). D. Accordingly, a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") dated the date hereof, with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, will be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording at the Land Records Division. E. Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are all within Block 4973.
